modalLead: One correction. When a search finds no shortcut but does know a bookmark by that name, it says so and names the key that gets there — and that key now works.

items.text: Pressing / after the hint actually searches names. Typing a bookmark's name looks for a shortcut first, and when there is none the overlay says so: “no shortcut by that name — press / to search names”. Pressing it did nothing at all. It switches now, and puts the query straight into a name search rather than leaving the slash sitting in the box.
